name: @spinjs/theme
description: DTCG JSON in, token trees out — the theme pipeline behind spin.

scripts.schema: bun -e "import { writeFile } from 'node:fs/promises'; import { spinThemeJsonSchema } from './src/contract/schema.ts'; await writeFile('schema.json', JSON.stringify(spinThemeJsonSchema(), null, 2) + '\n'); console.log('wrote schema.json');"
scripts.types: bun -e "import { writeFile } from 'node:fs/promises'; import { parseTokens, generateTypes } from './src/index.ts'; import { spinTheme } from './src/themes/index.ts'; const parsed = parseTokens(spinTheme); if (!parsed.ok) throw new Error(parsed.error); await writeFile('src/theme-types.d.ts', generateTypes(parsed.tree)); console.log('wrote src/theme-types.d.ts');"
scripts.skill: bun -e "import { readFile, writeFile } from 'node:fs/promises'; import { renderSkill } from './src/skill/index.ts'; const rendered = renderSkill(await readFile('./skill/SKILL.md', 'utf8')); await writeFile('./skill/SKILL.md', rendered); console.log('wrote skill/SKILL.md');"
